symbols_list.description: Search and retrieve company symbols, names, and identifiers across multiple exchanges. Required: Choose ONE filter - symbol, company_name, or cik. Only one filter is needed per request.

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company name - searches in primary and alternate names (choose ONE filter)

company_info.description: Get comprehensive company profile and fundamental data. Required: Choose ONE filter - symbol or company_name. Only one filter is needed per request.

business_segments.description: Access detailed company business segment data including revenue breakdowns by geography, product lines, and business divisions.

business_segments_quarterly.description: Revenue per fiscal quarter by business segment, product or service, region, country and other views (end markets, sales channels, customer types), from company filings. Includes parent and child items for drill-down, eliminations and corporate items, total revenue for each quarter and a flag for fourth quarters that are calculated as full year minus the first three quarters. Required: symbol or cik. The answer is {symbol, company_name, total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}. Annual figures stay in /business-segments.

params.name: cik
params.description: Company registration number (give symbol or cik)

params.name: perspective
params.description: segment, product, region, country, end_market, channel, customer, subsegment; comma-separated (default all)

params.name: from_date
params.description: Quarters ending on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: to_date
params.description: Quarters ending on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: latest_only
params.description: Only the latest value of each quarter (default true)

params.name: leaf_only
params.description: Only rows that are not parents of other rows

params.name: sort
params.description: period_end (default), fiscal_period, revenue, name, perspective or filed_date

business_segments_views.description: Which revenue views (business segments, products and services, regions, countries and others) a company reports, and how much quarterly history each has. Views that are reported only once a year are marked annual only. Required: symbol or cik. The answer is {symbol, company_name, views, about}.

params.name: cik
params.description: Company registration number (give symbol or cik)

business_segments_detail.description: Every revenue breakdown list a company reports in its SEC filings for one fiscal year, quarter or half-year, with all levels (for example segment > therapeutic area > drug > region), the parent of each item, partial lists, corporate and elimination items, and why a fourth quarter or second half-year is not shown. Required: symbol or cik. Two lists are two separate splits of the same revenue: never add two breakdown_ids together. The answer is {symbol, company_name, currency, fiscal_type, fiscal_period, periods, rows, truncated, notes, about}.

params.name: cik
params.description: Company registration number (give symbol or cik)

params.name: fiscal_period
params.description: FY2025, 2025Q3 or 2025H1; all for every annual or half-year period (default: the latest)

logo.description: Retrieve company logo images in various formats and sizes.

ma_transactions_summary.description: Access mergers, acquisitions, and investment transaction data for a company. Required: Choose ONE filter - symbol or company_name. Optional: transaction_stage, transaction_classification, date_announced can be added to refine results.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Company ticker symbol - searches both buyer and target (choose ONE filter)

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company name - searches both buyer and target (choose ONE filter)

params.name: transaction_classification
params.description: Merger, Acquisition, Private Equity, Venture Capital (optional)

sec_filings.description: Access company SEC filing documents and accession numbers.

presentations.description: Access company investor presentations and earnings presentations.

industry.description: Comprehensive industry and sector classification data for companies including NAICS, SIC, and revenue-based classifications. Required: Choose ONE filter - symbol or company_name. Only one filter is needed per request.

stock_price_1d.description: Real-time and historical daily price data with OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) for stocks, ETFs and indexes, e.g. AAPL, SPY, QQQ, TLT, GLD, ^GSPC (S&P 500; ^SPX also works), ^DJI, ^IXIC, ^RUT and ^VIX. In a URL, write ^ as %5E (ticker=%5EGSPC).

params.name: ticker
params.description: Ticker of a stock, ETF or index, e.g. AAPL, SPY or ^GSPC (choose ONE filter)

stock_price_5m.description: Intraday price data with 5-minute intervals for stocks, ETFs and indexes (e.g. AAPL, SPY, QQQ, ^GSPC, ^VIX), for day trading and technical analysis.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Ticker of a stock, ETF or index, e.g. AAPL, SPY or ^GSPC (choose ONE filter)

stock_news.description: Latest news articles and headlines related to specific stocks and companies.

press_release.description: Official company press releases and announcements.

gain_loss.description: Historical stock performance metrics showing gains and losses over various time periods.

params.name: status
params.description: Performance status: gainer or loser (choose ONE filter)

industry_performance.description: Aggregate performance metrics for entire industries, showing average price changes and trends.

industry_performance_pe.description: Industry-level Price-to-Earnings ratios and valuation metrics.

sector_performance.description: Broad market sector performance metrics and trends.

sector_performance_pe.description: Historical sector-level Price-to-Earnings ratios tracking valuation trends across market sectors. Required: Choose ONE filter - sector or exchange. Optional: date can be added as secondary filter. Available sectors: Basic Materials, Communication Services, Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Defensive, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Industrials, Real Estate, Technology, Utilities.

params.name: exchange
params.description: Stock exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX (choose ONE filter)

income_statements.description: Detailed income statements with full line items from SEC filings.

income_statements_summary.description: Summarized income statement data with key revenue, expense, and profitability metrics.

balance_sheet_statements.description: Complete balance sheet data showing assets, liabilities, and equity.

balance_sheet_statements_summary.description: Summarized balance sheet data with key asset, liability, and equity metrics.

cash_flow_statements.description: Detailed cash flow statements showing operating, investing, and financing activities.

cash_flow_statements_summary.description: Summarized cash flow data showing operating, investing, and financing cash flows.

earnings_transcripts.description: Full text transcripts from earnings calls and investor presentations.

earnings_split_calendar.description: Upcoming and historical earnings dates, stock splits, and dividend dates.

ipo_calendar.description: IPO listings and offering details by company.

market_calendar.description: Comprehensive economic and market event calendar with 400+ event types.

params.name: event_name
params.description: Economic event name (e.g., FOMC_Meeting, Nonfarm_Payrolls, CPI, GDP, Retail_Sales, etc.)

shareholders_by_type.description: Shareholder ownership breakdown by investor type (institutional, retail, insider).

shareholders_geo.description: Shareholder geographic distribution by country and region.

shareholders_class.description: Share class structure details including voting rights and class distinctions.

shareholders_quarterly.description: Quarterly shareholder data with changes in institutional holdings.

shareholders_quarterly_summary.description: Summarized quarterly shareholder data with aggregate statistics.

insider_transactions.description: List of all insider transactions including buys, sells, and option exercises.

insider_holdings_summary.description: Aggregated insider ownership and recent transaction summary.

insider_transaction_history.description: Historical insider transaction data with detailed transaction history.

elections_races.description: US elections as races: president, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, governor, other statewide offices, state legislature, ballot measures and judicial races, each with the winner or leader, the runner-up, votes and shares, total votes, margin, party margin, swing against the previous comparable race, whether the winning party changed, live reporting progress and the status of the numbers. All filters are optional and can be combined. The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}; sort is year, state, office, district, total_votes, margin, rd_margin, swing or name.

params.name: office
params.description: president, us_senate, us_house, governor, lt_governor, attorney_general, secretary_of_state, treasurer, other_statewide, state_senate, state_house, ballot_measure or judicial (comma-separated)

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter state code(s), comma-separated (US for the national race)

params.name: district
params.description: District number such as 07 (00 = at large)

params.name: special
params.description: true = special elections only, false = without them

params.name: winner_party
params.description: Party of the winner or leader: D, R or other

params.name: flipped
params.description: true = the winning party changed since the previous comparable race

params.name: q
params.description: Text in the race title or a candidate name

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows per page (default 50 to 100, at most 1000)

elections_results.description: The result of one race by area: the race header and every candidate with votes and share, then one row per state, congressional district, county, city or town, or precinct with total votes, Democratic, Republican and other shares, the leader, margin, party margin, swing, flip and turnout. The answer is {race, choices, level, total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}. sort is name, total_votes, rd_margin, margin, swing, dem_pct, rep_pct, turnout or state.

params.name: level
params.description: state, county, cousub, cd or precinct (default: the top level of the race)

params.name: county
params.description: Only areas inside this county (5-digit code); needed for precincts

params.name: include_choices
params.description: true = each candidate's votes in every row (top 8)

params.name: compact
params.description: true = short rows for maps, up to 4000 rows

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows per page (default 50 to 100, at most 1000)

elections_candidates.description: Candidates for president, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, governor and other statewide offices, with party, home state, years and the number of races and wins. Pass slug for one candidate with every race: year, office, state, party, votes, share and result. Members of Congress carry an official portrait link. The list answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}; with slug it is {candidate, races, about}. sort is name, last_year, first_year, races or wins.

params.name: party
params.description: Latest party: D, R or other

params.name: office
params.description: Ran for this office (comma-separated office codes)

params.name: won
params.description: true = won at least one race

params.name: in_congress
params.description: true = current or former member of Congress

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows per page (default 50 to 100, at most 1000)

elections_geography_level_code.description: One area in full: a state, county, city or town, congressional district or the nation. Every race with a result in the area (leader, shares, margin, swing, flip), partisan lean, bellwether record, split tickets, turnout by election and main demographics. The answer is {area, lean, bellwether, races, split_tickets, turnout, demographics, about}.

params.name: level
params.description: national, state, county, cousub, cd, sldu or sldl (in the path)

params.name: offices
params.description: Only these offices in the race list (comma-separated)

elections_area.description: The latest elections for a state, county and city in one call: for each level (nation, state, county, city or town when matched) the last presidential results with margin, shift and flip, the last Senate and governor races, partisan lean and turnout. Made for pages and assistants that show the elections of a place. The answer is {levels, coverage_note, about}.

elections_summary.description: Analysis views over the election data: national presidential vote by year, seats won in Congress and governorships, control of state legislatures, areas that flipped or swung most, bellwether states and counties, split tickets, partisan lean, county results next to demographics, and what is loaded. The answer is {view, total, limit, offset, rows, about}.

params.name: view
params.description: trend, seats, legislatures, flips, swing, bellwethers, split_tickets, lean, demographics or coverage

params.name: office
params.description: Office filter (flips and swing). For demographics: president (default), us_senate, governor or us_house, the county results of that race next to county demographics

params.name: chamber
params.description: us_house, us_senate, governor, state_senate or state_house

elections_turnout.description: Voter turnout by state or county and election: votes in the biggest race, citizen voting-age population from the matching five-year survey, turnout as a share of citizen adults and, where reported, ballots cast and turnout of registered voters. The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}; sort is turnout, top_office_votes, cvap, name, year or registered_turnout.

params.name: min_turnout
params.description: Lowest turnout, % of citizen voting-age population

params.name: max_turnout
params.description: Highest turnout, % of citizen voting-age population

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows per page (default 50 to 100, at most 1000)

elections_live_races.description: Races that are being counted right now on election night, each with the candidate who is leading and the runner-up, votes and shares, the lead in votes and points, the percent of precincts reported and the time of the last change. Counts are unofficial and still changing. A race is only ever shown as leading, never as won. All filters are optional. The answer is {updated_at, unofficial, note, total, rows}. Before any state starts counting the rows list is empty.

params.name: office
params.description: president, us_senate, us_house, governor, lt_governor, attorney_general, secretary_of_state, treasurer, other_statewide, state_senate, state_house, ballot_measure or judicial (comma-separated)

params.name: close
params.description: true = only close races (lead under 5 points)

params.name: sort
params.description: updated, margin, state, office, total_votes or reported

elections_live_summary.description: One light answer for an election night page: for each office how many races are being counted and how many are led by each party, for every state whether live results are coming in and when they last changed, and the next counting windows. All numbers are unofficial. No parameters. The answer is {updated_at, unofficial, note, has_live, is_live, election, offices, states, windows, district_lines}.

politician_trades.description: Stock trades reported by members of the US Congress in their official House and Senate financial disclosure filings: who traded, party, chamber, state, ticker, asset name and class, buy or sell, amount range, who holds the asset (held_by), trade date, filing date and a link to the official filing. All filters are optional and can be combined. Lists use commas (symbol=AAPL,MSFT). The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}; total is the number of matching trades.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Ticker(s), comma-separated (BRK.B and BRK-B both work)

params.name: party
params.description: Party on the trade date: D, R, I (or Democrat, Republican, Independent)

params.name: trade_type
params.description: buy, sell, or purchase, sale, sale_partial, sale_full, exchange, other

params.name: asset_class
params.description: Asset class as filed, e.g. Stock, ETF, Stock Option, Corporate Bond

params.name: held_by
params.description: Who holds the asset: Self, Spouse, Joint or Child

params.name: trade_from
params.description: Trades on or after this trade date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: trade_to
params.description: Trades on or before this trade date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: filed_from
params.description: Filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: filed_to
params.description: Filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: days
params.description: Only trades from the last N days (by trade date)

params.name: amount_min
params.description: Smallest estimated amount in US dollars (middle of the range)

params.name: amount_max
params.description: Largest estimated amount in US dollars (middle of the range)

params.name: late_filing
params.description: true = only trades filed more than 45 days after the trade

params.name: has_symbol
params.description: true = only trades with a known ticker

params.name: include_other_filers
params.description: Also include filers who are not members of Congress (default false)

params.name: sort
params.description: trade_date (default), filed_date, amount_mid, member_name, symbol or filing_delay_days

politician_trades_summary.description: Totals of congressional trades for charts and analytics, grouped by party, member, symbol, month, year, chamber, trade type, asset class, who holds the asset, state, amount range or filing delay. Two groupings at once make a cross table, for example month and party. Required: group_by. Every filter of /politician-trades also works here (member_id, member_name, asset_class, held_by, state, trade_from, trade_to, filed_from, filed_to, amount_min, amount_max, late_filing, has_symbol, include_other_filers). The answer is {group_by, date_basis, sort, order, total_groups, limit, offset, groups, totals, about}.

params.name: group_by
params.description: One or two of: party, member, symbol, month, year, chamber, trade_type, asset_class, held_by, state, amount_bucket, delay_bucket

params.name: date_basis
params.description: For month and year: trade (trade date, default) or filed (filing date)

params.name: party
params.description: D, R or I (party on the trade date)

params.name: trade_type
params.description: buy, sell or a detailed type

params.name: days
params.description: Only trades from the last N days

params.name: sort
params.description: trades, buys, sells, buy_value, sell_value, net_value, members, symbols, last_trade_date, first_trade_date, avg_filing_delay_days, median_filing_delay_days, late_filings or key (default: key for month, year and buckets, otherwise trades)

politician_trades_members.description: Members of Congress who reported trades, with party, chamber, state, district, whether they are in office, trade counts, buys, sells, estimated values, average filing delay, late filings and their five most traded symbols. All filters are optional. Also accepted: trade_type, asset_class, held_by, trade_from, trade_to, filed_from, filed_to, late_filing, include_other_filers. The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}.

params.name: party
params.description: Member's current party: D, R or I

params.name: in_office
params.description: true = only members in office today

params.name: country
params.description: US (default), DE (German Bundestag) or NL (Dutch House of Representatives). With DE or NL the rows are members with side_jobs, interests and outside income (income_total, income_latest) instead of trades; sort income, side_jobs, interests or name

params.name: symbol
params.description: Only count trades in these tickers

params.name: days
params.description: Only count trades from the last N days

params.name: sort
params.description: trades (default), buys, sells, buy_value, sell_value, net_value, symbols, last_trade_date, late_filings, avg_filing_delay_days or name

politician_trades_symbols.description: Tickers traded by members of Congress, with company name, trades, buys, sells, estimated buy and sell value, net value, distinct members, the split by party and the last trade date. All filters are optional. Every filter of /politician-trades also works here. The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}.

params.name: q
params.description: Part of a ticker or company name

params.name: party
params.description: D, R or I (party on the trade date)

params.name: trade_type
params.description: buy, sell or a detailed type

params.name: days
params.description: Only trades from the last N days

params.name: sort
params.description: trades (default), buys, sells, buy_value, sell_value, net_value, members, last_trade_date or symbol

politician_trades_member_search.description: Find any member of Congress, current or former, with or without reported trades, by name, nickname or initials (for example Pelosi, Bernie or AOC). The answer is {q, rows, about}.

params.name: q
params.description: Name, part of a name, nickname or initials

params.name: in_office
params.description: true = only members in office today

politician_trades_net_worth.description: Net worth of members of Congress from their yearly financial disclosure reports, per member and report year: assets and liabilities as ranges, net worth range and middle estimate, number of assets, the share held by the member, spouse, jointly and by children, and the five largest assets. All filters are optional. The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, about}.

params.name: year
params.description: Report year (the calendar year the report covers)

params.name: latest
params.description: true = each member's latest year with figures (default without year and member_id)

params.name: in_office
params.description: true = only members in office today

params.name: data_status
params.description: parsed (with figures) or paper (scanned, no figures)

params.name: sort
params.description: net_worth (default), net_worth_min, net_worth_max, assets, liabilities, assets_count, name or year

politician_trades_net_worth_summary.description: Net worth of members of Congress grouped by party, chamber, state or report year: members, median, average and total net worth (middle estimates), median assets and liabilities, members worth over $1 million and $10 million, and the richest member of each group. The answer is {group_by, year, groups, about}.

params.name: in_office
params.description: true = only members in office today

politician_trades_assets.description: The assets listed in a member's yearly financial disclosure report, with asset class, ticker, who holds it, the value range as filed and an estimate, and the income it paid; plus the report's net worth, its liabilities and the report years available. Or, with a ticker, the members whose latest report lists that stock. member_id or ticker is required. The answer is {member_id, year, total, rows, summary, liabilities, years, facets, about}; summary, liabilities, years and facets come with member_id.

params.name: member_id
params.description: Official member ID (required unless ticker is given)

params.name: ticker
params.description: Ticker; without member_id: the members holding it

params.name: asset_class
params.description: One or more of our asset classes, comma-separated

params.name: sort
params.description: value (default), name, asset_class, held_by or line

politician_trades_interests.description: Side jobs, outside income, company stakes, donations and benefits (Germany), and side activities, side income, gifts and paid travel (Netherlands) reported by members of the German Bundestag (from 2013) and the Dutch House of Representatives. These countries publish no stock trades. Also accepted: state (German state, English name), in_office, category, ticker, order. The answer is {country, total, limit, offset, sort, order, rows, as_of, about}.

params.name: party
params.description: Party key or short name(s), comma-separated

params.name: interest_type
params.description: side_job, side_income, stake, donation, gift, travel, prior_job, or income (any row with an amount)

params.name: org_type
params.description: Organization type, e.g. Private company, Foundation, Association or club

params.name: q
params.description: Words in the role, organization or description (original language)

params.name: has_amount
params.description: true = only rows with an amount

params.name: sort
params.description: year (default), yearly_value, amount, reported_date, start_date, member_name, organization or category

politician_trades_interests_summary.description: Totals of the German and Dutch disclosures grouped by party, member, year, type, category, organization type, state, organization or ticker: record counts and outside income in euros. Every filter of /politician-trades/interests also works here (member_id, member_name, party, state, in_office, interest_type, org_type, q). The answer is {country, group_by, total_groups, groups, totals, currency, as_of, about}.

params.name: group_by
params.description: party (default), member, year, interest_type, category, org_type, state, organization or ticker; one or two

params.name: listed_only
params.description: true = only records linked to a listed company

params.name: sort
params.description: income (default), interests, members, side_jobs, stakes, with_amount, income_range_min or key

politician_trades_holdings.description: Company stakes disclosed by members of the German Bundestag: company, legal form, organization type, city, since and until dates and the latest reported income from the stake. The Netherlands publishes no holdings. Also accepted: member_id, party, in_office, ticker, order, offset. The answer is {country, total, limit, offset, rows, currency, as_of}.

params.name: listed_only
params.description: true = only stakes in listed companies

government_contracts.description: Federal government prime contracts of listed companies, from official US government data: contract awards of $1 million or more with the agency, amount, award date, period of performance, place of performance, product or service category and description. A company includes the units it owns today. All filters are optional and can be combined. The answer is {total, limit, offset, sort, order, data_as_of, latest_award_date, rows, about}. The demo key works with symbol=AAPL, MSFT or WMT.

params.description: Words in the description, unit name or contract ID

params.name: award_type

params.name: fiscal_year

params.name: state

government_contracts_summary.description: Federal contract obligations of listed companies (contracts of every size) for charts and rankings: by US fiscal year, by fiscal quarter, by awarding agency, or companies ranked by obligations. params.name: group_by
